caption:
the day everything moved and the plan moved with it

#routine #busylife #fitness

slides.text:
Gym bag by the door
at 8am

Still there at 8pm

Lunch at the desk

Protein first, still counts

Twenty minutes at home
instead of forty at the gym

Walked the calls

Six thousand steps
I would have skipped

slides.heading: The plan bends before it breaks
slides.body: SOMA rebuilds the session around the time and the equipment you actually have today
